reviews.text: This place is a money trap. They offer a free initial visit but basically make you come in multiple times subsequently, even to get results, and then charge you an arm and a leg. Avoid at all costs.

My appointment was at 7:30 PM. I called ahead to let them know I was running late and was told there was a 10-minute grace period. I arrived at 7:41 PM and they refused to see my *SICK* dog. The policy is the policy, but the complete lack of compassion or empathy is extremely disappointing!!!
Where is this?

Unfortunately, after my experiences with Bond Vet, I would not choose them again.

My cat has had recurring severe flu-like symptoms throughout her life. After two visits and hundreds of dollars, they were able to rule out feline herpes, but could not determine what was actually causing her symptoms—whether allergies, chronic sinus issues, or something else. I left with medication, but no real diagnosis or answers. The staff was kind, but the medical experience fell short of my expectations.

More recently, I booked a Sunday appointment for vaccinations needed for travel. The night before, they texted suggesting I reschedule to Monday when a specific doctor would be available. I replied that I might not be able to make Monday, but received no response.

I rearranged my plans and booked Monday at 7:30 pm. They then texted asking me to arrive 10 minutes early because it was the doctor’s last shift. I said I could probably arrive even earlier, and they thanked me. I arrived at 6:30 pm, only to be told I would have to wait until 7:30 because that was my appointment time—and that “the doctor didn’t send those messages.”

The vaccination itself was given in their clinical area, where pet owners are not allowed, so I was not able to be present when my cat received it. I was then given the vaccination certificate without the vaccine label attached and had to specifically ask them to add it.

Between the lack of answers regarding my cat’s health, the communication issues, and this last experience, I’ve lost confidence in this practice. If someone had shared this experience with me beforehand, I would have chosen a different vet.

The vets and all the staff at this clinic are incredibly nice, thorough, and helpful. My cat was urgently sick and needed surgery, but I could not afford surgery at the emergency vet I took her too. I would have had to wait til Monday for surgery at the aspca. They fit me in for surgery the next day (Sunday) and worked with me for me to be able to afford the surgery. I’m so grateful for this vet clinic. They gave me back my cat when I thought I lost her.

We brought Ozzy in to get a check up and get something on his head checked out. Dr. Helen, nurses and staff did such a thorough job and turned out he actually had a really bad ear infection. The Vet Tech, Grethil went above and beyond, showing us exactly how to clean his ears and answered all questions and quelled all of the worries we had. Her bedside manner was so wonderful and refreshing and she treated Ozzy as her own. Recommend this Bond Vet and their team very highly!

This location was not the best experience for me they stressed my baby out. Nevertheless the nurse KNOWS so much but couldn’t realize she was trying to squeeze a too small muzzle over my Frenchie and was wondering why he tried biting her. Not only that’s probably why the prior dog bit her I can imagine what she was doing as she stated she just gotten bit and don’t want another one but my dog has never bite or tried to bite anyone I know she made him uncomfortable. I will never go back here because  if someone can make a small mistake like that and couldn’t realize that the muzzle  was too small for his head constantly trying to shove it on him until I saw and told her it’s way too small and took it from her . I ended up holding my baby which worked out better with the lady that was administering his medication after having to ask several of times to hold him myself.  My baby  never had not one issue at a doctor’s appointment. The way she kept pulling on my baby’s harness to control him just wasn’t right. I don’t think that nurse handle dogs very well at all. Not only they take the dog away to do ear cleaning. When that could have just been done right in the room with the parent so their pet is not afraid. Then the lady in the front had an attitude because I asked about extra charges  that was on my bill after signing. I won’t be back here. I won’t  tolerate it especially when I’m spending my money.

Dr.Helen Yu, Grethil and Dante
I had such a great experience at Bond Vet with my dog, Milo. The veterinarian, nurse, and assistant were all incredibly kind, patient, and attentive while helping him with his eye.

I especially want to thank Gretil, who was extremely helpful throughout the visit. She is bilingual and took the time to explain everything to me in Spanish, which made it much easier for me to understand what was going on with Milo and feel comfortable with his care. I really appreciated her patience, kindness, and willingness to make sure I understood everything.

The entire team made a stressful situation feel so much easier, and I’m very grateful for the care and compassion they showed Milo. Thank you for taking such good care of my boy! 🐾❤️
Dr Barrena and Grethil and Sabrina. They took very good care of us and explained everything throughly. Answered any concerns that I had for my little kitten 10/10

We made a walk in appointment request because we wanted to see if they could see our new puppy. We submitted it TWO HOURS before the walk in time at 12 PM, got confirmation, and literally got into a taxi and traveled all the way there.

Then, FIVE MINUTES before our appointment, the front desk person suddenly messaged us saying they were not able to see her and that we would have to wait until 7:30 PM.

We asked why they waited until literally FIVE MINUTES before our appointment to tell us, and we never got an answer. The front desk person was incredibly unhelpful and completely failed to explain what happened.

We were so disappointed. We were actually hoping this would be our puppy’s forever vet because the place has such great reviews, so we were genuinely excited to bring her here.

Instead, we spent time making the walk in request, getting confirmation, taking a taxi all the way there, only to be told at the last possible second that they couldn’t see her.

Honestly, what a frustrating first impression. If you knew you couldn’t see us, why on earth wait until 5 min before the appointment to let us know?
Dr.Yoon, Grethil, and Selena were an amazing team that were extremely helpful in making sure my two kittens were safe and taken care of! Thank you guys so much!
Dr. Yoon, Grethil, Selena, were AMAZING!!! They helped my dog so much, I love bond vet!!

Esther Yoon, Grethil, and Selena all helped me today.  They were so great and patient with my diabetic cat who was lethargic and not eating. Dr. Yoon had great bedside manner and took the time to explain everything in detail with me. This is my first time at this specific location but I will be coming back, thank you again to all the staff that helped!
Dr. Esther Yoon Grethil and Salena. They are amazing and so kind to my pets. They are extremely thorough and spent so much time walking me through everything. I feel safe with my cats in their care!
Dr. Esther Yoon, Grethil and Salena were amazing!! They took very good care of my pup. Can’t wait to see them again 😊. …

I was blown away by Bond Vet. They made getting treatment, updated vaccines and a wellness exam for my cat seamless, affordable and helpful. Everyone I interacted with at the client was helpful and genuinely happy to be there. You can tell the staff loves the animals they care for and truly want to set up pet owners for success. 10/10 vet experience!

Dr. Thomasch is the best vet in all of NYC. She saved my dog’s life by being proactive and catching a hidden mass before it could have ruptured. I don’t have enough amazing things to say about her. She treats my dog with love and joy and I will not ever even consider going to another vet.

It was wonderful experience. Stephen and Dr Yu took good care of my cat. Front desk was polite and helpful, such a caring team. My cat is a very shy cat and alert to all strangers yet she responded well. Appreciate it!
Excellent service! Grethil took the time explain how to use Bachee sensor and to take my time. She is the sweetest with my baby ❤️.

Apparently they've closed the Narberth, PA location without any customer notification? And this is the only number available to contact? I'm trying to get a new Simparico script for my dog. Apparently he needed a new heartworm test when we came in for a visit in May, but they never told us. This company is outrageously expensive compared to competitors, but the "excellent service" they promised is nowhere to be found. Now my dogs medication might lapse because of their incompetence and unprofessionalism. Unbelievable.

Been to this location twice when my primary care in Astoria did not have availability. Both experiences were great, even though I come to this location for one off issues I feel everyone is very caring and thorough. I have never felt rushed, and I feel like I can trust and rely on this bond vet location for the future or for second opinions.

Called to get a consultation after learning my cat had bladder stones. They did have a bot take the call and stuff but they were responsive. After leaving a message with the bot, they quickly reached back out bought by calling and texting me to get more information and quick scheduled a same day in person consultation. After letting me know all my options they gave a very reasonable quote and got a surgery schedule for next day.

Overall loved how responsive and kind the staff were. I would highly recommend this location.

I brought my cat here twice for rounds of shots. Pricey, but typical for the neighborhood, and first visit free is nice (w/ promo code). The nurses are very sweet and lovey with my cat. Gave him churu both times.

Reception area is large. It’s easy to block sight of other pets while waiting to be taken back.

I had a good experience but not everyone does.

I overheard another pet parent arriving to pick up their pet from surgery. They arrived on time, only to be told “We texted you 15 minutes ago that your pet needs another hour to recover” because body temp was still too low.

The pet parents never received this text, despite having received other texts about the appointment. The text never arrived. So they showed up on time, in the middle of a work day, only to learn they’re an hour early.

First, imo, 15 minutes is not enough of a heads up. Second, reception should have called! Left a voicemail or spoken on the phone. Email or texting isn’t enough. Makes reception seem lazy.

Bond Vet should improve their communication methods. It’s easy and would make a huge difference.
It, is like Starbucks for Vet. Emergencies...1/2

Dr. Barrena and Nurse Grethil and Stephon were amazing and helpful with Oliver. Nurse Grethil explained in great detail how to administer the fluids to Oliver and allowed me to practice and ask questions. They all supported us with our fears about Oliver and allowed us to move at our own pace with his treatment. Grethil is the best nurse we’ve ever seen.
Great experience with BondVet! Highly recommend!!

I cannot say enough good about Bond Vet staff at the 62nd St. location. Their end of life care for our cat was informed and compassionate. A particular thank you to Dr. Yoon and Dante, as well as Dr. Yu and Dr. Barrena.
Esther Yoon, grethil, Jose were all fabulous with helping my dog’s tail recovery!

the bond vet at 62nd is our main bond vet that we go to and we cannot say enough good things about this vet :) my dog has been going to bond vet since she was a puppy and recently my new kitten goes here as well! the doctors I would absolutely recommend is dr Halle thomasch and dr Keith lewy! Amazing vets who care for your fur babies :)
Great place!

Doctor Keith Lewey and Grethil & Selena they were so kind so patient and so efficient with my kitten! I’m so grateful for them! grethil spent extra time with me teaching me how
To apply my kittys medication and is so special! Loved the team

Grethil Rodriguez was very helpful and even though I couldn't afford certain services she took her time to help me figure out other options....Thor and I appreciate how sweet and caring she was to help me get the services that I needed I can't thank her enough...
Warm and friendly.  So helpful. Went above and beyond for our Rex.
Get experience with Dr. Lee and staff were patient and examined thoroughly.
Dr. Barrena, Grethil, and Beatriz were great will speckles. They took care of her and make sure she was feeling better in no time. Very attentive and kind!
Dr Yoon, Grethil & Selena were very caring with my dog. Very thoughtful in communication with me too. Also came up with a plan with options on how to treat my dog, Lulu
Dr Yoon was great, explained all procedures and issues as well as giving us all of our options for care.

I’ve had a really positive experience with the team at Bond Vet Upper East Side. Polo has had ongoing allergy and skin issues, dental care, vaccines, and follow-up visits, and the staff has always been patient, compassionate, and thorough with his care.

They’ve been especially helpful coordinating care and taking the time to explain treatment options and follow-up plans. Polo can be anxious during visits, and the team has consistently handled him with patience and kindness, which means a lot to me as an owner.

I also appreciate how responsive and communicative the doctors and staff have been throughout everything. It’s clear they genuinely care about their patients and work hard to make both pets and owners feel comfortable.

Very grateful for the care Polo has received here.
We’re so kind to us - very impressed.

Dr Lee was great! He was very patient and did an amazing job on Uni. Angela was the nurse and monitored Uni! She took very good care of her and made sure was ready to go with Bernie. Grethil also did amazing she took me through the process of the aftercare for Uni which is VERY helpful!!!
Dr Lewy, Selena and Grethil were so amazing!!! They answer every question and are so helpful! They always have great offers and events. Great place highly recommend!
I had a flight to take my puppy on and she needed a rabies vaccine- they got me in same day right away! Dr Lewy was so wonderful!! Grethil and Selena were so kind to my little girl!

Dr. Barrena, Grethil, and Selena helped take care of our dog immensely. They helped us out with what they could to take care of our diabetic dog, and we feel extremely safe with bringing him to this clinic. We'll continue coming here in the future for his needs. Thank you so much! I recommend them highly.
Came in with my recently adopted husky who wasn’t feeling well and BondVet was so helpful and patient with my new dog!
A friendly neighborhood veterinarian. Well-rounded staff and knowledgeable.
Today  GRETHIL good explain very well my dog what happened, I’m really appreciate.

Loved my experience at Bond vet on 62nd- it’s an all inclusive, one stop shop for your beloved little fur baby. My little man came here for his dental cleaning and he is leaving with a few less but pearly white teeth. The staff were informative, polite and took care of my little guy.

We had an amazing visit at Bond Vet at 62nd! The care and dedication is palpable, and it makes the stress of our annual visit with our senior cat so so easy. Dr Yoon is brilliant, so kind and excellent at explaining, Beatris was super efficient and helpful, and Grethil was so sweet, personable and clearly capable. I highly suggest visiting this location!!

Saw Nalani for an emergency limping situation right away. Staff was accommodating understanding and let me know the options I had for her! Service was quick and Nalani was not tense or scared, just a bit nervous!
dr yu and grethil dante were great!
Grethil, was very attentive and sweet to my dog and me! 100% recommend :)
On time, super professional, thorough, patient and kind. Thank you!
Always the best! Thank you to Dr. Keith, Grethil, and Dante!

The entire team at the Upper East side bond vet have been wonderful! We had the pleasure of working with Dante, Grethil, and Dr. Keith! They were wonderful with Sunny and Penny, made them feel incredibly comfortable and safe when they were out of the room and away from us! We had a wonderful experience. Thank you guys so much!!
Awesome! Lou loves them. Dr. Yu Grethil Sabrina

Had such a wonderful experience with a dental cleaning. Was concerned with my boys age of 13yrs but all my concerns were addressed and he was taken so well care of.
Dr. Tomasch, Angela and Grethil were his care team and evertythjng from intake to discharge went so smoothly and most importantly he was cared for so well by everyone.
Dr Yu, Grethil, and Sabrina all did a fantastic job. Thank you so much.
Dr. Yu, Grethil, and Sabrina were excellent today. They got everything sorted out efficiently and couldn’t be happier
Dr Yu, Grethil and Sabrina were fantastic! Linus and I appreciate you all :)
Dr. Yu, Grethil, Sabrina. Everytime we come we have a great experience. I can trust my pets at Bond Vet.
Always a great experience at Bond Vet with Dr. Thomasch. She is extremely attentive and makes sure I understand every step in my cats care. I wouldn’t take my pets anywhere else.
Great experience! They are fast, compassionate, and convenient.
Dr Barrena was incredible! Grethil was sooo sweet and helpful. And Selena was an amazing help!

Treated my cat with patience, gentleness, care, and kindness. This team was Dr. Barrena, Grethil, and Selena. My cat is not feeling well and they came up with a comprehensive plan. Would highly recommend.
Dr.Barrena and Grethil and Selena are fantastic. They were all very helpful and knowledgeable. Especially Grethil with all her advice and wisdom.
Dr. Yu was great and very easy to work with. She was very clear with everything and helped us out a lot. Grethil has great customer service, her hospitality was amazing. Had a good visit!
Bond Vet got us in very quickly when we needed care after moving to the city. Would recommend! Dr Yu, Grethil, and Stephon were amazing!
All the staff members at UES 62 are amazing and take great care of our 3 dogs. Also highly recommend Dr Thomasch if you have dachshunds!
Great experience. Very friendly and helpful. My dog can be difficult and he did so well with the team there. Highly recommend Dr. Yu and Grethil and Stephon.
Wonderful staff and they are so great with my baby! Dr. Yu and Grethil and Stephen were phenomenal and answered all my questions. Amazing!!!
Quick and easy. Great staff and treatment of my sweet boy
I saw Dr Yu, Grethil, and Stephon at this location and they were all so kind and helpful! Great experience and love this vet

Brought my miniature Doxie Taco for his annual checkup, amazing care from Dr. Yu, Grethil, and Stephon! They took such great care of him, with lots of love as well! Highly recommend coming here and seeing them!
Dr. Thomasch and Beatriz were great. We were able to get in and seen the morning of. They were very kind and transparent and handled our Albie with great care.
Dr. Lewy, Grethil, and Selena were so helpful with Ella and made her feel so comfortable

Grethil,  Angela , Beatriz , Dr . Esther

He looked perky and alert considering he just had general anesthesia.
The staff was Very thorough  and was detail
In her  instructions post up and upon discharge .
I appreciate  the  sincerity to help and make the whole procedure pleasant experience  for our dog and for  all of us who love Spencer .

👍🥰
